title: EV-SIENT cohort input, version 1: one row of sites.csv
description: One row per candidate site. Only site_id is required. A value nobody recorded is left blank: it earns no credit and is never replaced by a guess (DEC-011). docs/INPUT_SCHEMA.md describes every field and the other files a cohort may hold.

site_id.description: A unique, stable identifier for the site. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

site_name.description: Display name. Not a model input.

site_type.description: What the building is, e.g. library, office, recreation, garage. A type containing 'garage' is routed to fire/AHJ review before any normal buildout.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees. Projected coordinates are refused, never converted.
lat.x-if-absent: the map surfaces are unavailable; nothing else changes

lon.x-if-absent: the map surfaces are unavailable; nothing else changes

employees_day.description: Staff on site on a typical day. Drives expected charging sessions, not the score.
employees_day.x-if-absent: counts as 0 expected sessions from staff

visitors_day.description: Visitors on a typical day. Drives expected charging sessions, not the score.
visitors_day.x-if-absent: counts as 0 expected sessions from visitors

fleet_vehicles.description: Fleet vehicles based at the site. Read and carried, not used.

parking_spaces.description: Parking spaces at the site. Also caps the port plan at 5% of spaces (2 to 12).
parking_spaces.x-if-absent: earns no credit, and the port plan is capped at 2

hours_open.description: Hours the site is open on a typical day. A '_min' column is recognised and converted.
hours_open.x-if-absent: earns no credit; port sizing assumes 8 hours

avg_dwell_min.description: Average length of a visit. An '_hr' or '_sec' column is recognised and converted.
avg_dwell_min.x-if-absent: earns no credit; port sizing assumes 120 minutes

nearby_households_1mi.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

nearby_jobs_1mi.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

aadt_nearest.description: Annual average daily traffic on the nearest arterial.
aadt_nearest.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

amenities_count_0_5mi.description: Amenities (shops, services) within half a mile.
amenities_count_0_5mi.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

ev_share_local.description: Share of locally registered vehicles that are electric, as a fraction: 0.03 means 3%.
ev_share_local.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

existing_l2_ports_1mi.description: Public Level 2 charging ports already within 1 mile. Lower is better.
existing_l2_ports_1mi.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

existing_dcfc_ports_3mi.description: Public DC fast charging ports already within 3 miles. Lower is better.
existing_dcfc_ports_3mi.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

equity_gap_index.x-if-absent: earns no credit; the contract's equity_indicator is left empty

spare_capacity_kw.description: Spare electrical capacity at the service. Used in the score, but the contract reports capacity as a placeholder until a utility or facility confirms it. Watts and megawatts are recognised and converted.
spare_capacity_kw.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

distance_to_service_ft.description: Distance from the parking area to the electrical service. Lower is better. Metres are recognised and converted.
distance_to_service_ft.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

trenching_ft.description: Trenching needed. Lower is better. Metres are recognised and converted.
trenching_ft.x-if-absent: earns no credit, and the site gets no cost figures

trench_cost_per_ft.x-if-absent: the install-cost term earns no credit, and the site gets no cost figures

service_upgrade_cost_usd.description: Cost of upgrading the electrical service. Lower is better.
service_upgrade_cost_usd.x-if-absent: earns no credit, and the site gets no cost figures

elec_service_rating_amp.description: Rating of the electrical service. Read and carried, not used.

public_access.description: Is the site open to the public? Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.
public_access.x-if-absent: treated as not public: demand counts at 65%, the 'Low public-priority' tier, and every port target held to 2

ada_layout_possible.description: Can an ADA-accessible charging layout be built? Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.
ada_layout_possible.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

fire_access_ok.description: Is fire-service access adequate? Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.
fire_access_ok.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

garage_enclosed.description: Is the parking an enclosed garage? Yes lowers the safety score. Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.
garage_enclosed.x-if-absent: earns no safety credit, and the site is a 'High-review candidate'

emergency_disconnect_visible.description: Is an emergency disconnect visible from the charging area? Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.
emergency_disconnect_visible.x-if-absent: earns no credit in the score

stormwater_risk.description: Is there a stormwater or flooding risk? Yes lowers the safety score. Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.

battery_storage_flag.description: Is battery storage on site? Read and carried, not used. Write yes/no, 1/0 or true/false; leave blank if nobody knows.

x-cohort-files.sites.csv: required: one row per site, the fields above
x-cohort-files.electrical_risk.csv: optional: site_id, electrical_risk_level (low | medium | high); default medium
x-cohort-files.site_meta.csv: optional: site_id, arrival_start_hr, arrival_end_hr, base_load_mean_kw, base_load_peak_kw; default arrivals from 08:00 for the opening hours, base load unknown
x-cohort-files.provenance.csv: optional: site_id, field_group, source_class, verification_status, source_org, source_date, reviewer, assumption_type, unresolved_flag; default 'unconfirmed' everywhere
x-cohort-files.cohort.json: optional: cohort_id, jurisdiction, source_date (YYYY-MM-DD), source_org; defaults from the directory name and 'unstated'
